name: Laundromat free-deposit ring withdrawal
summary: Laundromat's deposit function did not enforce its configured payment, allowing the attacker to fill the remaining participant slots with chosen keys, satisfy the ring-signature withdrawal flow, and withdraw 1 ETH without depositing it.
notes: The direct Laundromat runtime was created by this transaction and remained unchanged through the exploit.
The exploit trace records exactly 1 ETH leaving Laundromat for the attack contract. It is valued at the nearest pre-exploit CoinGecko observation.
